title: acaena pinnatifida var. calcitrapa
intro: Acaena pinnatifida var. calcitrapa, commonly known as New Zealand caterpillar or silver broom, is a perennial plant native to New Zealand. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as wound healing and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Acaena pinnatifida var. calcitrapa include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its ability to reduce pain, swelling, and infection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
